name: Money rain
what: Things raining through the frame - coins that flip and notes that sway, near ones big and fast, far ones small, slow and soft, a few glowing; or confetti, hearts or stars. The frame is full from the first frame.

learned_from.what: coins and notes falling at different speeds through a black frame, a few glowing

motion: each piece falls in 80-150 f by its depth, coins flip and notes sway twice a fall, seeded
